svg.title: Three orbits
svg.desc: Precessing, zoom-whirl and plunging orbits around a Schwarzschild black hole.
svg.text: L = 3.78M, E = 0.9737: out to 30M, then whirls
near r ≈ 4M before zooming out again
L = 3.2M: below L = √12 M the potential has no
well; it spirals in and crosses r = 2M
Three orbits Newton's gravity cannot draw
integrated from d²u/dφ² + u = M/L² + 3Mu²; the dotted circle is r = 6M
